creative_strategies.description: Showing real gameplay footage of base building and zombie battles
Opening with a dramatic survival scenario or story moment
Emphasizing multiplayer alliance gameplay and cooperation
Showing rapid progression, rewards, and leveling up

inferred_targeting_strategy.primary_audience: Male 25-45, strategy game enthusiasts, midcore gamers
inferred_targeting_strategy.secondary_audience: Male 18-24, action game players, zombie genre fans
inferred_targeting_strategy.retargeting: Users who played similar strategy games (Rise of Kingdoms, State of Survival)
inferred_targeting_strategy.lookalike: Based on high-value payers in strategy genre

noteworthy_ads.body_preview: The zombies are coming. Your city is all that stands between them and total destruction. Build your walls, train your troops, and fight alongside millions of players worldwide...
noteworthy_ads.why_noteworthy: Combines FOMO (zombie threat) with social proof (millions of players) in first 3 seconds

noteworthy_ads.body_preview: I started with nothing but a tent. Now I command the strongest alliance on the server. Here's how I did it in 7 days...
noteworthy_ads.why_noteworthy: Uses personal storytelling format that drives high retention

noteworthy_ads.body_preview: 3 reasons why your base keeps getting destroyed — and how to fix it
noteworthy_ads.why_noteworthy: Carousel format allows sequential storytelling, higher engagement rates

overall_assessment.strategy_focus: Last War focuses heavily on urgency-driven narrative hooks combined with real gameplay footage. The creative strategy emphasizes the survival threat (zombies) as the primary emotional driver, with alliance/social gameplay as the secondary hook for retention messaging.
overall_assessment.competitive_position: Directly competing with State of Survival, Whiteout Survival, and Rise of Kingdoms for the same strategy game audience. Differentiation is through zombie theme and modern military aesthetic.
overall_assessment.estimated_ad_spend: $50-100M annually (estimated based on creative volume and market presence)
